objective: Replace the frozen-scenario placeholder pass with a fail-closed simulation control surface that exposes doctor, list, and run workflows, preserves bounded runner evidence, and never presents scripted fixtures or missing Gazebo execution as release-eligible simulation success.
acceptance: the frozen regression command has no placeholder success or hard-coded VTCR and exits non-zero when Gazebo or its runner is unavailable
doctor and list expose simulator readiness, scenario identity, task, fault, timeout, and deterministic scene hash without starting motion
scripted run output is explicitly marked SCRIPTED_FIXTURE and release_eligible false while remaining usable in the read-only dashboard
external execution uses each manifest timeout, captures stdout and stderr, records exit and timeout metadata, and terminates the whole launched process tree on timeout or interruption
each run preserves the source manifest, materialized scene, validated event log, metadata, and SHA-256 checksums using an atomic run directory publication
missing executables and zero executed scenarios are reported as NOT_EXECUTED and can never satisfy a regression threshold
same manifest and seed materialize to the same scene hash without claiming deterministic Gazebo event ordering
no interface, Motion, firmware, hardware safety, or dashboard write boundary changes are introduced
commands: python -m ruff check tools/scripts/sim_cli.py tests/regression/run_frozen_scenarios.py tests/unit/test_sim_cli.py
python -m ruff format --check tools/scripts/sim_cli.py tests/regression/run_frozen_scenarios.py tests/unit/test_sim_cli.py
python tools/scripts/sim_cli.py run normal-001 --runner scripted --output-dir runs/sim-smoke
evidence: unit tests covering missing runner, timeout cleanup, non-zero exit, malformed output, deterministic scripted artifacts, and zero-execution regression behavior
doctor and scenario catalog console output
a scripted fixture run directory with manifest, materialized scene, events, metadata, logs, and checksums
a Gazebo-unavailable regression summary showing NOT_EXECUTED and a non-zero command exit
scenario validation and focused Ruff output
stop_conditions: a truthful runner requires changing interfaces or contract models
a real Gazebo task requires unfinished semantic Motion, canonical WorldState, trajectory, or correlation dependencies
the implementation would need to publish robot, ROS, MCU, or emergency-stop commands from the dashboard
scripted fixtures or generic external runner output would be promoted to release-eligible evidence
the process tree cannot be bounded and terminated on timeout or interruption
